snapshot.title: Time Jump: 07:30 — Boil Water Advisory Mandate

fields.narration: It is now 07:30. The Hilltop Transmission Main break has caused the Hilltop Tank level (LIT-601) to fall below 12 ft and stabilize at 11.2 ft, as confirmed by on-site sight gauge. The pressure at Millbrook General Hospital has dropped to 14 psi and remains low. Water Quality has confirmed that the chlorine residual at the Orchard Standpipe outlet (AIT-611) is undetectable, and the loss of disinfection has lasted 70 minutes. Based on ERP Section 4.4 Level 3, the team must now issue a Boil Water Advisory for the entire Zone 2 area (Hilltop, Eastfield, and north-facing parts of downtown).

The Director of Water Operations has authorized manual operation of the Carver County Water District interconnect (IC-1) at Mill Road Booster Station.
The Public Information Officer has activated the emergency call script (Section 10.7) and is drawing six additional agents from the Utility Billing and Permits counters.
The Water Quality Manager confirms that the loss of pressure and disinfection meets Level 3 criteria and that a Boil Water Advisory must be issued.
